# Vocabulary: substrate

Computational representation the mechanic is usually implemented on. A mechanic may have several.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `aggregate-stocks` | Aggregate stocks | Numbers updated by rates and equations (system dynamics). |
| `agent-based` | Agent-based | Individual entities with state and decision rules. |
| `cellular-grid` | Cellular grid | Values on a lattice updated by local neighbor rules. |
| `network-graph` | Network / graph | Nodes and edges with flows, paths, or influence weights. |
| `continuous-physics` | Continuous physics | Numerical integration of continuous dynamics (rigid bodies, fluids, orbits). |
| `rule-system` | Rule system | Discrete condition-action rules, recipes, or state machines. |
| `stochastic-events` | Stochastic events | Random draws from distributions or weighted decks. |
| `player-authored-logic` | Player-authored logic | Code, circuits, or blueprints written by the player. |
| `learned-model` | Learned model | Neural network or other trained model evaluated at runtime. |
| `ui-layer` | UI layer | Presentation logic over other substrates; owns no simulation state. |
